A Claude skill that explains an idea by building it as a real, working object.
Also runs in Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex and MiniMax Code.
Crafted, interactive isometric figures with many small precise parts, in SVG, WebGL and 3D.

   

Quick start · Gallery · What it makes · Install · Usage · Examples · How it works · Limits

examples/raptor-engine, light theme, firing. The engine and stand are SVG; the plume is a WebGL shader in the same isometric camera.

--- Ask Claude for a figure that explains a technical idea, and Anatomy has it invent a physical thing whose working *is* the concept. A cache key that skips work when nothing changed becomes a pin-tumbler lock that only turns when every pin matches. One GPU context serving many canvases becomes a gantry plotter whose single print head visits 16 wells. Then Claude builds that thing out of dozens of small, solid, shaded parts, puts it in a framed card with a title, a hint and a live readout, makes it move calmly under the pointer and the keyboard, and checks its own work by zooming in on every joint. To skip the question, add `-a claude-code`, `-a antigravity`, `-a opencode`, `-a codex`, or `-a minimax-code`. content.readme:
# unslop

Created by Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)), who started the [Unslopping series](https://x.com/heydamir/status/2115063463063998736) on X.

![A vibecoded dashboard unslopping itself, frame by frame](skills/unslop/references/refs/story-dashboard-frames.webp)

unslop is a skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character. It finds the slop first, the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, then sets a direction from your product and fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review. It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS, on dashboards, apps and landing pages, and even on a live site when all you have is a link.

## Install

For Claude Code, copy the skill into your skills folder.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.claude/skills/
```

For a single project, copy it into `.claude/skills/` inside that project instead.

For Codex, ask it to install the skill straight from this repo.

```
$skill-installer install https://github.com/heydamir/unslop/tree/main/skills/unslop
```

Or copy it by hand into `~/.agents/skills/`, or into `.agents/skills/` inside a single project.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.agents/skills/
```

To snapshot a live site or create a story video, install Playwright and its Chromium browser from the project directory where you run the skill:

```bash
npm install -D playwright
npx playwright install chromium
```

Story videos also require ffmpeg installed and available on your PATH.

## Use

In Claude Code, type `/unslop` with what you want. In Codex, type `$unslop` the same way. Or just ask in your own words and the agent picks the skill up by itself.

```
/unslop this dashboard
/unslop the hero of https://example.com
/unslop my landing page and make the story video so I can post it
```

It audits the screen and proposes a direction before it edits anything, so you can steer it early. If the screen is already good, it tells you so and suggests a few small refinements instead of redesigning it.

## What it does

- **Audit.** Lists every sign of slop with where it lives.
- **Direction.** Character, world, the one or two moments that carry the color, and a signature detail, all taken from your product.
- **Passes.** Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.
- **Visuals.** Shows your product instead of a glossy blob. When a hero needs a scene or an object, it can generate one through an image service like fal, Replicate, OpenAI images or Higgsfield. If none is connected, it offers to connect one as an MCP server, and it shows the prompt and asks before every paid generation. Dashboards and apps rarely need one.
- **Story video.** A square video under 10 seconds of your screen unslopping itself, ready to post. It needs Playwright and ffmpeg.

Try it on the two vibecoded screens in [examples](examples).

## Hire the unslopper

Would rather have a designer do it? Damir unslops one key screen in 3 days, built in your stack, at [heydamir.design/unslop](https://heydamir.design/unslop).

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) # huashu-art-motion · 艺术动画 让你的coding agent，把艺术风格写成会动的画。 36种艺术风格 · 9种解说语法 · 8种参数化片段 · 口播整片参考代码 ```sh npx skills add alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion ``` [看动画](#动画样片) · [看风格](#看效果) · [开始使用](#里面有什么) · [下载完整样片](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest)
## 动态 - 2026-10：[Open Design](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design)（nexu-io 出品的开源 AI 设计工作区）的 [motion-design skill](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/blob/main/skills/motion-design/SOURCES.md) 把 huashu-art-motion 列为设计来源之一，并在 [skills/huashu-art-motion](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/tree/main/skills/huashu-art-motion) 收录了一份适配版，保留了 MIT 许可和上游出处。很高兴这套艺术动画的做法被另一个开源项目用起来，谢谢 Open Design 团队。也欢迎更多项目使用、反馈和贡献。 ## 动画样片 ### 核心案例：花叔闯进超级玛丽 把自己做成像素主角，跑完一整关。砖块、水管、关卡运动与转场用代码完成，人物用生成帧合成；下面直接截自65秒成片。 连吃蘑菇都得先选会员：OpenAI，还是Claude？选完Claude，星芒道具落下来，花叔变大。

连踩带踢 · 像素Sam与Dario客串敌人
钻进水管 · 金币密室与扫描线甩镜
这组展示的是成片效果；GIF无声、循环播放。[片段时间点与导出参数](assets/showcase/mario-clips.md)。 ### Clawd 博物馆奇妙夜 Claude Code 的像素吉祥物 Clawd 从保安电脑的终端里蹦出来，打着手电夜巡纽约大都会博物馆，再穿过中央公园去自然史博物馆，天亮前赶回来装成展品。98秒，16个场景，无口播，配乐也是代码合成的。 跳进梵高《麦田与柏树》：笔触方向取自原作的结构张量，Clawd被重画成厚涂。

霸王龙骨架 · 追手电光斑
天亮 · 装成展品眨一下眼
暗处是炭笔夜景，只有手电照到的地方显出颜色；入画的五幅（梵高、修拉、维米尔、伦勃朗、勒茨）都是大都会开放获取的CC0原作，按各自画家的笔法用代码重画。完整成片在[Releases](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest)，[片段时间点与说明](assets/showcase/clawd-clips.md)。 ### 花叔穿越名画 画里真的会动。下面三段来自同一支穿越短片，场景用代码画，角色用生成帧合成。 日本桥上的一次水漂。

古埃及 · 圣甲虫
8-bit · 顶出金币
## 看效果 35段样片各取一帧：同一位少女、同一只橘白猫、同一张桌子，从公元前 40000 年的岩洞一路穿到 2026 年。每一段都在动：梵高的星空在转，马赛克的颜色从石块上流过去，水墨晕染把画面带进下一个时代。 注意：这 35 格用的是同一个构图，那是艺术史速通片的机制（风格在变、场景不变），不是这些风格的构图。做新题材要为题材重新构图，别把这间屋搬过去。 👉 [下载全风格样片（MP4）](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest) 长卷穿越片：一个人从左走到右，跨过边界的那一刻，世界和他自己的画风一起换（下图是收进仓库的 3 段示范：埃及壁画 → 莫奈《日本桥》→ 8-bit）： 8种解说语法各有一支可运行示范片（下图每镜取一帧）。此外还有第9种「讲解员式财经科普」，提供语法卡和需自备角色的整片代码快照。白板适合跟着口播画关系，Vox适合图形与信息拼贴： | | | |---|---| | Kurzgesagt：扁平无描边、尺度穿行 | Vox：剪报、红线、荧光笔 | | 白板：笔尖揭开线稿 | 3Blue1Brown：一个对象形变成下一个 | | Storytime：反应特写、笑点停顿 | 动态文字：主词砸进来 | | 发布会：光斑底、毛玻璃卡、大数字 | 财经图表：先轴、后数据、只标一件事 | --- ## 能做什么 | 你说 | 它做 | |---|---| | 「复刻这个动画」「拆一下这段」 | 先跑拆解脚本量出转场、节拍网格、每段运动热图，再按机制用代码复刻 | | 「做个梵高／莫奈／包豪斯那种的动画」 | 先设计一帧，再让它动起来；36张风格配方卡当起点 | | 「用我的口播做一段艺术动画」 | 镜头表 → 定风格 → 世界画布加镜头 → 输出一条画面轨 | | 「做一个人穿过一幅幅名画的片子」 | 长卷骨架：每个世界一个段文件，主角一路往右走，跨边界换画风，镜头只进不退 | | 「做解说视频的动画段」 | 按口播选语法，喂一份 JSON，出一段时长精确到帧的片段（横竖屏、可透明底） | | 「画面里要有人」 | 人交给生图模型出帧，代码负责合成、换帧和材质 | | 「配个乐、卡节奏」 | BPM 网格、动机换乐器、结尾音效序列，纯代码合成 | 交付前有一道数字验收：`qa.py` 量稳定、效率、动感、流畅及文字框景线索，再派一个没参与制作的 agent 只看成片挑问题；最后 `deliver.py` 一条命令交付——成片先过反 PPT 门禁（整片几乎没有镜头内快动作就红灯，不出片），过了才复制成片、写交付说明，说明里的事实由脚本写。 --- ## 里面有什么 | | 数量 | |---|---| | 艺术风格配方卡（参数、母题动作、签名转场、当前短板） | 53张，`references/风格配方/`；其中 38–55 是按原作锚定重做的研究配方（含敦煌壁画） | | 对应的场景代码 | 53个，`scripts/engine/scenes/` | | 解说动画语法卡 | 9份；其中8种附示范片、参数化片段与示例spec | | 口播整片参考代码 | 混合风格、白板、Vox、讲解员；需自备部分素材，详见目录README | | 长卷穿越片示范（骨架＋3 段＋角色帧库） | 1 支，`scripts/engine/demos/long_scroll/` | | 版面审计与压测（出界／叠字／字太小、竖屏／超长／英文变体、示例回归） | `render.py --audit`、`scripts/clip_lint.py`、`scripts/analyze/stress_clip.py`、`regress_clips.py` | | 转场 | 艺术风格签名转场与解说转场，包含淡入、硬切和纸面转场 | | 绘画与动画库（笔刷、渲染器、后期、骨架、镜头、图表、排版……） | 17 个，`scripts/engine/lib/` | | 方法文档（拆解、机制、一帧先行、纯代码绘制、节奏配乐、角色、长卷……） | 核心12篇

content.readme: # pixelfx. **244 pixel art effects and animations, every one a small piece of code.** Fire, explosions, magic, weather, UI, pickups, critters and more. Play them live, recolor and mirror them, drop them into a browser game, or export sprite sheets for any engine. Plus a Claude Code skill that makes new ones the way a picky pixel artist would: draft, render, look, refine. Every effect that involves a character is **acted out**: he winds up, lets go, freezes on contact and recovers, and a target takes the hit. Twelve whole moves chain the effects into attacks from wind-up to recovery. **[open the gallery](https://patch-gg.github.io/pixelfx/)** · [catalog](docs/CATALOG.md) · [acting](#acting) · [the skill](#the-skill) · [make your own](#make-your-own) · [how it works](#how-it-works) The method is [Hugo Duprez](https://x.com/HugoDuprez)'s, from [How to make (good) pixel art effects with Claude](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/how-to-make-good-pixel-art-effects-with-claude): code is clay, trust your eyes, feed your references. His [open-source effects](https://www.spritefusion.com/pixel-art-vfx) at Sprite Fusion set the bar, and `src/core/sim.js` and the effects that say so at the top adapt his code. This repo is our take on the idea at library scale, with a skill to keep going. ## what's in it. | category | effects | some of them | |---|---|---| | **moves** | 12 | arrow shot, dash strike, earth stomp, fireball throw, ground pound, holy smite… | | **fire** | 12 | brazier, campfire, candle, fire breath, fire ring, fire tornado… | | **explosions** | 12 | barrel explosion, big explosion, cartoon pow, dirt explosion, firework burst, firework rocket… | | **water** | 12 | bubbles, drip, fountain, geyser, rain splash, ripples… | | **ice** | 10 | blizzard vortex, freeze, frost breath, frost nova, # dsh-purge Community **让 AI 更专注地辅助你的学习与动手实验。** 给 DeepSeek Harness 的自托管控件（俗称「破甲」插件）· 84 条宿主补丁 · 25 层状态自检 · 左侧栏整页设置 [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge?label=release)](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/releases) [![Checks](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/actions/workflows/community.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/actions/workflows/community.yml) 当前版本 **1.6.76** · 适配 **DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1**（0.2.1-rc.1 / rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.5 同样通过） · [English](docs/README.en.md) 1.6.76 修复 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 的预设加载，并校正旧版宿主的观察策略诊断。[发行说明](docs/releases/1.6.76.md)。 **原项目与作者**：基于 [小杨 / YuJunZhiXue 的 dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) 独立维护。原仓库已恢复；保留原作者署名、版权与 MIT 许可证。社区版由本仓库维护，并非原作者官方发行。
--- ## 搭配：本机出图（Qwen Studio） 破甲之后最直接的玩法，是把「生图」也搬到本机——不用网页、不用会员、不把提示词发到别人服务器。 配套插件 **Qwen Studio**（`dsh-qwen-studio`）把 Qwen Image 2.1 接进 DSH： - **Apple Silicon Mac**：MLX / MFLUX 本机推理，模型用时加载、空闲释放； - **Windows / Linux + NVIDIA**：连你自己的 GPU 网关（ComfyUI 或 vLLM-Omni 协议），也支持 SSH 按需拉起； - 支持参考图编辑（按图改画风、换材质）、LoRA、ControlNet、蒙版、整套预设、图库与批量任务； - 装好之后，会话里直接说「画一张…」或「把这张改成水彩」，Agent 调用 `qwen_generate_image` 并把图返回到对话里。 **组合效果**：破甲让 Agent 不再反复确认「要不要画」，出图插件让它真的画出来，全程在你自己的机器上完成。 **仓库**：[kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio) · **下载**：[最新 Releases](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/releases/latest) · **安装与硬件自查**：[docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md)（先看「这台机器能不能跑」再动手） ## 它是什么 dsh-purge Community 是一个跑在你自己机器上的 Harness 附加组件。它把日常使用里最消耗注意力的几件事收敛到一处： - **看清楚状态**：安装、补丁、注入到底有没有就绪，一条命令或一屏面板给结论； - **少一些往返**：把反复出现的确认与打断，收敛成一次设置； - **随时能回去**：应用、回滚、开关都留记录，操作前自动快照； - **方便做实验**：提示词、规则、预设集中管理，改坏了能撤。 目标很简单：**让助手更连贯地配合你的学习与动手实验**，而不是每做一步都先停下来问一句。 社区里通常把它叫作「破甲」或「无限制模式」插件——指的是它降低了交互层面的摩擦，让 agent 能连续执行任务；它不改模型本身，也不改变你要做的事。 ### 下载时报 `fetch failed`？ 1.6.39 起，独立安装器会显示失败阶段和错误码，有限重试后可切换系统 curl；两条通道都保留来源、证书和 SHA256 校验。请先重新下载安装脚本再运行 dry-run，仍失败时提交脱敏诊断行即可。见 [下载排查说明](docs/maintenance-issue-52.md)。不会自动修改代理或重启 DSH。 ### 让不同预设保留自己的提示词 1.6.40 新增 `excludePresets`：默认空列表，保持原有行为；可将 `roleplay`、`minimal` 等预设排除在 Purge 提示词注入之外，保留命令、面板与工具。切换预设、并行会话和子 Agent 各自判断，宿主兜底也遵守排除。配置示例、升级步骤与边界见 [按预设排除说明](docs/maintenance-issue-53.md)。这不会撤销全局宿主补丁。 ## 设计原则 | 原则 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | 本机优先 | 全部逻辑在本机运行，不改云端账号、不上传提示词或配置 | | 可见 | 每个动作都有状态与证据，不靠"应该生效了"这种判断 | | 可回滚 | 应用 / 安装 / 回滚前自动快照，保留原文件与校验清单 | | 不替你做决定 | 只减少摩擦，不改变你的目标；改什么、开什么，都由你确认 | ## 适用场景 本机学习、个人项目、自动化实验与维护工作。请在你拥有或已获授权的环境中使用；涉及他人系统时，先取得许可。 ## 1.6.39 更新 修复独立安装器只显示 `fetch failed` 的问题：分阶段诊断、有限重试和系统 curl 备用下载，继续严格校验官方来源、证书和 SHA256。下载失败不触碰现有安装。[发行说明](docs/releases/1.6.48.md) · [配置与验收](docs/maintenance-issue-52.md) ## 安装 **DSH 官方入口负责安装插件；下面的社区安装器由本仓库维护，不是 DeepSeek 官方脚本。** 首次安装可用官方界面或 CLI；已经装过 `dsh-purge` / 旧独立面板时，用社区安装器原地迁移，不要先卸载。安装、应用宿主补丁、手动重启是独立动作。 ### 方式一：DSH 官方界面（首次安装） 1. 先打开 DSH 完成初始化。按当前官方文档，进入「插件」，点击「实验性插件」旁的「更多」，启用「自定义插件市场」；然后进入「发现 → 添加索引源」。 2. 本项目的**社区索引**：`https://kingcharleslzy-ai.github.io/dsh-purge/index.json`。 3. 选择 dsh-purge Community，核对来源为 `kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge`、包名为 `dsh-purge-community`，确认后安装。 界面和安装协议由 DSH 提供，索引与插件由社区维护。不同 DSH 版本的入口文字可能不同；第三方 `dsh-market` 也可能有额外的筛选与迁移限制。已有旧包时请使用方式三。[官方市场说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/guide/plugin-market.zh.md) ### 方式二：DSH 官方 CLI（首次安装） 下面命令适用于**已经安装 `dsh` 命令、且使用 `web` profile 的 CLI/Web 用户**，在 macOS/Linux 终端或 Windows PowerShell 中运行。桌面版用户优先用上面的界面；不要为了安装插件再用 `npx` 下载另一套宿主。 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/releases/download/v1.6.76/dsh-purge-community-1.6.76.tgz" ``` `web` 必须与实际启动的 profile 一致；自定义数据目录需要沿用该实例的 `DSH_HOME`。命令使用本次发行的固定版本 URL；不是 `npm install -g`，也不是安装裸 npm 包名。本项目通过 GitHub 发行，**不要替换成 `add dsh-purge` 或 `add dsh-purge-community`**。官方 CLI 的安装不会额外运行我们安装器的 Release SHA256 比对及迁移快照；需要这些功能时选方式三。[官方 CLI 安装说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.zh.md) ### 方式三：社区安装器（备份、旧版迁移、恢复） 先安装并打开一次 DSH，让实际 profile 初始化。以下命令下载**本仓库的脚本**，先校验，再安装；`dry-run` 通过仅代表前置检查、下载和 SHA256 通过，不代表依赖安装、迁移或启动已通过。请先阅读下载的脚本。 #### macOS Desktop 默认应用位置 `/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app`、数据目录 `~/.dsh`、profile `desktop`。将下面两段放在同一个终端会话中执行： ```sh PURGE_INSTALL_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" curl -fSL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 90 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/master/scripts/install.sh" -o "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" --dry-run ``` 校验成功、核对目标实例后执行： ```sh sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" ``` 自定义应用或 home 时，先设置 `DSH_APP` / `DSH_HOME`；自定义 profile 对两次命令都加 `--profile=实际名称`。不要照抄别人的路径。 macOS 支持从 XML/二进制 plist 读取真实可执行文件名；元数据无效会停止，不会换用其他应用。详见[定位边界](docs/INSTALLATION.md#应用定位边界pr-78)。 #### Windows Desktop · PowerShell 5.1 / 7 脚本会尝试定位唯一的 DSH Desktop，默认 home 为用户的 `.dsh`。旧 Desktop CLI 默认 profile 为 `desktop`，带独立 dsh CLI 的新壳默认为 `web`；自定义 profile 用 `-Profile` 指定。不要求管理员

TwinDesk

Your Mac, your PC, your Linux box and your Android phone, working as one desk.
One mouse and keyboard for all of them. Their screens, apps, files, clipboard, cameras, calls and texts, shared.
Free and open source. No account, no cloud, no shared network needed.

⬇️ Download 2.5 · Website · What's new · What it does · Get started

## What is TwinDesk? You probably own more than one computer. A work laptop and a gaming PC. A MacBook and the Windows machine you can't give up. A Linux box under the desk. And a phone that's never more than a metre away. Each one is great on its own. Together they're a mess: two keyboards, files emailed to yourself, a phone you keep picking up, the same tab opened three times. **TwinDesk turns all of them into one desk.** Push the mouse off the edge of your Mac's screen and it carries on onto the PC, keyboard and all. Copy on one, paste on the other. Drag a file across the edge and drop it there. Open the PC's apps in windows on your Mac. Turn a tablet or an old laptop into a second screen. Answer your phone's calls and texts from the computer, use its camera in your video calls, and drive the computer from the couch with it. And when you walk from one device to another, **ReZume** brings the tab, the video or the document you were on with you. It's one app on every platform, so a Mac and a PC pair exactly like two Macs, and a phone is a full peer instead of a notification mirror.

# teardown

A Claude Code skill that turns any machine into a 3D simulator you can take apart.

Ask how something works. Claude builds it as one offline HTML page: the machine runs in the middle, every panel around it reads the real numbers, a button opens the part doing the work, and when nobody touches it the page tours itself.

![Mellis HB-7 robotic bee simulator](docs/bee.gif)

| Telson SC-8 robotic scorpion | Pelagos OC-8 robotic octopus |
|---|---|
| ![Telson SC-8 robotic scorpion](docs/scorpion.gif) | ![Pelagos OC-8 robotic octopus](docs/octopus.gif) |

## Install

```
npx skills add elvarofficial/teardown -g -a claude-code
```

Then, once, in the installed folder:

```
npm install && npx playwright install chromium
```

You need Node.js 20 or newer. For the video you also need `ffmpeg`, and for the sound Python 3.

## Use

Ask Claude Code in plain words:

> Build me a simulator of a 4-stroke motorcycle engine I can take apart.

> How does a mechanical watch keep time? Show me as a simulator.

> Make a teardown of a hydraulic excavator arm and record a 20-second video of it.

Or open one of the 3 examples first:

```
node sims/build.mjs v8-live          # teardown-out/dist/v8-live.html
node sims/build.mjs cessna-live
node sims/build.mjs strandbeest-live
```

## What is inside

| | |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | What Claude reads: how a machine is built, the rules that make it look right, the review loop. |
| `sims/kit/` | Runtime, stage, shader warm-up. |
| `sims/v8-*`, `sims/cessna-*`, `sims/strandbeest-*` | 3 complete machines. `-shared` is the machine, `-live` the page you drive, `-film` the recorded tour. |
| `sims/build.mjs` | Bundles a machine into one HTML file, three.js and fonts inlined. |
| `sims/capture.mjs` | Renders the film frame by frame to a 60 fps mp4, or to review sheets of stills. |
| `sfx/`, `run_sfx.py` | Procedural sound on the film's timeline, mastered to −14 LUFS. |

## Credits

Built on [whaleyxbt/claude-motion](https://github.com/whaleyxbt/claude-motion) (MIT): the runtime, frame capture, sound engine and review rules come from there. Recorded samples are CC0 from Freesound, prepared by [Barty-Bart/motion-graphics](https://github.com/Barty-Bart/motion-graphics); sources in `sfx/samples/SOURCES.md`.

MIT licence.

content.readme:
# Roast Room

![The Roast Room](docs/room.jpg)

Bring a hard business decision and a council of AI advisors argues it out, then hands you a scored verdict and a one-click PDF. Twelve advisors ship with it, each built from that person's public work: their letters, essays, talks, and videos. For each question, the Chair recommends who should sit on the council and you confirm. The council runs in Claude Code, and a small local web app shows them around a table talking it through. Want someone else at the table? Type `/newroaster` and a name, and Claude builds that advisor the same way.

| Seat | Pillar | The question they own |
|---|---|---|
| Jeff Bezos | Strategy and decisions | Is this the right bet, and how reversible is it? |
| Paul Graham | Product and startups | Do people actually want this, and is it growing? |
| Alex Hormozi | Offers, pricing, and sales | Will people pay, how much, and how do we close? |
| Gary Vaynerchuk | Marketing and attention | Where does the attention come from? |
| Dan Martell | People, hiring, and founder time | Who does this, and what does it cost your calendar? |
| Gino Wickman | Operations and scaling | Can the business run this without you holding it together? |
| Warren Buffett | Money and capital | What does it do to cash, risk, and long-term value? |

Those seven are the **default board**. Five more advisors are on call, and the Chair brings them in when your question is in their lane:

| Seat | Pillar | The question they own |
|---|---|---|
| Naval Ravikant | Leverage and wealth | Does this build leverage and equity you own, or does it just rent out your time? |
| Codie Sanchez | Buying and owning small businesses | Should you build this, or buy something that already works? |
| Leila Hormozi | Leadership and scaling teams | Can your team and your leadership carry this, and who has to change? |
| Sara Blakely | Consumer product and brand from zero | Will customers love it enough to sell it for you, without outside money? |
| Elon Musk | First principles and execution speed | What is the real constraint here, and can we cut steps and build it faster? |

## What you need

- [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). Your Claude plan covers it; no API key needed.
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) 20 or newer, for the room. There's nothing to install beyond that.

## Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nateherkai/roast-room.git
cd roast-room
```

Or open Claude Code anywhere and say: "Clone github.com/nateherkai/roast-room and start the room for me."

## Run a roast

1. Start the room: `npm start`, then open http://localhost:4730. Leave it open.
2. Open Claude Code in the same folder: `claude`
3. Type `/roast-room` and your decision.
4. Answer the Chair's questions, then watch the council argue it out in the room.
5. When the verdict lands, click **Download PDF**.

You also get a short verdict in Claude Code, and the full report lands in `sessions/<date>-<decision>/verdict.md`.

## What to put in your question

The council is only as good as what you give it. Include:

- **The decision** in one line.
- **Your options.** Two or three. "Keep doing what I do now" counts.
- **Your numbers.** Revenue, cash, and team size.
- **Your limits.** Deadline, hours, and budget.
- **What success looks like**, and by when.
- **Which way you're leaning**, and why. The council tests your lean instead of agreeing with it.

Left something out? The Chair asks before the council starts. Example:

```
/roast-room I run a coaching business at $30k a month with 15 clients at $2,000 each.
Should I raise to $3,500 for everyone, raise for new clients only, or keep $2,000?
Close rate is about 50% and I have $40k in the bank. Success is $45k a month by March.
I'm leaning toward raising for everyone because I'm underpaid.
```

More ways to run it:

- `/roast-room --quick ...` seats four advisors for two rounds. Use it for smaller, reversible calls. It uses far less of your plan.
- `/roast-room --seats hormozi,buffett ...` seats only the advisors you name.
- `/roast-room ask hormozi ...` gets one answer from one seat.
- `/roast-room --all ...` seats every advisor you have (up to nine).
- `/roast-room board` shows who sits at the table by default and lets you change it.

The room is optional. The council runs the same in Claude Code without it.

## Choose who sits at the table

When you run `/roast-room`, the Chair reads your question and recommends a council from every advisor you have, with one line on why each one fits. You pick:

# Gr8r Studio

A calm, structured project management workspace: home dashboard, inbox, my tasks, projects with
board / list / table / calendar / timeline / files views, members, teams, activity and settings.

Built with plain JavaScript ES modules and CSS, bundled by [Vite](https://vite.dev). There is no
UI framework and no runtime dependency.

![Gr8r Studio home dashboard](docs/preview.png)

## Getting started

Requires Node.js 18 or newer (`.nvmrc` pins 22).

```bash
npm install
npm run dev       # http://localhost:5173 with hot reload
npm run build     # production build in dist/
npm run preview   # serve the production build locally
npm run lint      # ESLint
npm run format    # Prettier
```

## Project structure

```
index.html              HTML entry; loads src/main.js
public/favicon.svg      brand mark
vite.config.js          Vite config, including the Lucide icon-subset plugin
eslint.config.js        lint rules (ESLint flat config); formatting by Prettier (.prettierrc.json)
.github/workflows/      CI: lint, format check, build
docs/preview.png        README screenshot
src/
  main.js               entry: imports styles and modules, then boots the app
  styles/
    index.css           imports every stylesheet in cascade order
    tokens.css          colours, spacing, type, radius, the shared --gutter
    base.css  components.css  shell.css  panels.css  overlays.css  states.css  motion.css  responsive.css
    views/              list, board, table, calendar, timeline, projects & files
    pages/              settings, auth & onboarding
  core/                 utilities, constants, icons, store (state + lookups), theme
  data/seed.js          demo workspace data
  ui/                   shared render helpers, toasts, the select dropdown
  shell/                render loop and router, sidebar/topbar layout, skeletons, view engine
  components/           task list renderer
  pages/                one module per route
  views/                project views: board, table, calendar, timeline, files, overview
  overlays/             task drawer, modals, popovers, context menu, command palette
  features/             teams, subtasks, archive (rendering)
  actions/              user actions, event wiring, keyboard shortcuts, drag and drop
```

### Layers

Dependencies point downward:

1. `core/` and `data/` depend on nothing else in the app.
2. `ui/`, `shell/`, `components/`, `pages/`, `views/`, `overlays/` and `features/` render HTML from state.
3. `actions/` change state and re-render. Each action module registers its handlers on the
   shared action table (`A`) when it loads, so `main.js` imports them after `actions/actions.js`.

## Conventions

- **Rendering:** each page or view is a function that returns an HTML string from the store
  (`S`). `render()` rebuilds the shell and keeps focus and scroll positions.
- **Interactions:** elements declare `data-a="actionName"`. `actions/events.js` delegates the
  click to `A.actionName`. Inputs use `data-in`, blur handlers use `data-blur`.
- **Layout:** every page edge uses `var(--gutter)`, so the breadcrumb, page header, toolbar,
  list, table and board start on the same line.
- **Dropdowns:** write a normal `<select class="select">`. `ui/select.js` renders it as the
  design-system menu and keeps the native element as the source of truth.
- **Icons:** call `ic('name')` with any [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) icon name. The
  `virtual:icons` plugin bundles only the icons the source uses.

## Continuous integration

Every push and pull request runs lint, the format check and a production build
(`.github/workflows/ci.yml`).

## Deploy

`vercel.json` builds with Vite and serves `dist/`.

MailCheap

Newsletters where you pay for the emails you send, not for dormant subscribers.
A fraction of the price of beehiiv and the like.

Website · API docs · Sign up for MailCheap Cloud

![MailCheap's overview: emails sent, delivery, open, click, bounce and complaint rates, and subscribers over the last 30 days](docs/screenshots/overview.webp) MailCheap is a newsletter app: write an issue, send it to your list, publish it on the web, from the dashboard or from your AI agent. This repository is the whole app. Self-host it with your own Amazon SES or PostShiba account, or use [MailCheap Cloud](https://mailcheap.ai), which runs this same code. ## Features - **AI agents and the dashboard.** Everything the dashboard does also works from an AI agent through the MCP server, and from code through the REST API, with the same checks and limits. ChatGPT, Claude and Grok Bot connect with OAuth; Claude Code, Codex and Cursor with an API key. MCP marks sending as an action that can't be undone, so agents ask you first. - **Write, review, send.** Write in an editor with slash commands, images and boxes, or send Markdown or a complete HTML email through the API and MCP. Review shows what to fix before sending: subject, preview text, unsubscribe link, Gmail's 100 KB clip, postal address, sender. Then send it, schedule it, or start with your most engaged readers and send to more later. - **Imports from beehiiv, Substack and Mailchimp.** Their CSV exports import as they are, with each reader's status and signup date, and so do Kit's, MailerLite's, Buttondown's, Ghost's, EmailOctopus's and listmonk's. - **A website for each newsletter**, on a free subdomain on MailCheap Cloud (`.mailcheap.ai`), or on your server: every issue gets a page search engines can find, with a signup form, an author page, share images and a sitemap. - **Sending from your own domain**, with the DKIM, return path and DMARC records to add and a check for each. On MailCheap Cloud, a newsletter without a domain sends from its own shared address, `hello@.mailcheap.ai`. - **Deliverability protections**, built in: - sending pace: contacts the account never emailed go out in steps, a random 2% first, then 5% more, then the rest, 30 minutes apart while their bounces and complaints stay low. On MailCheap Cloud, a domain new to Gmail also sends to its first 2,000 Gmail readers on its first day and to the others the next day; - list cleanup, on by default: readers who ignored several issues get one "do you still want this?" email, then stop getting issues; - contact cleaning: imports leave out invalid, misspelled (gmial.com), spam trap, role, throwaway and duplicate addresses, domains that can't receive email, and anyone who unsubscribed, bounced or complained before; - one never-email list for the whole server: an address the email provider says doesn't exist (for 180 days) or that turned out to be a spam trap (for good) is left out of every account's imports, signups and sends, and only a keyed hash of it is kept; - spam and bounce limits: a send pauses past 2.5% hard bounces or 0.08% complaints, and the account is blocked past 5% or 0.3%, or on a spam trap hit; - Gmail's spam rates, which Gmail never reports one complaint at a time: every email carries a `Feedback-ID` for Gmail's feedback loop (its campaign or newsletter, its account, its kind), and once an admin connects [Google Postmaster Tools](https://postmaster.google.com), MailCheap reads it every day. An account Gmail flags at 0.08% has its sends paused, at 0.3% it's blocked, and the admins hear when the whole domain reaches 0.1%; - one-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058) and a signed unsubscribe link in every email, and confirmed opt-in, on by default. - **Several newsletters**: up to 3 per account, each with its own contacts, campaigns and website. - **Signups and stats**: signup forms and a signup API, welcome emails, open and click tracking that leaves link scanners out, subscribers over time, and reports by inbox provider (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud...). | Write, review, send | The newsletter's website | | --- | --- |

# PHP Version Checker

Get a version-based PHP2Shell warning from a website's PHP headers or local installation.

To install both skills, ask Codex:

```text
$skill-installer install both skills from https://github.com/openai/php2shell-checker
```

Use [phpcheck-server](skills/phpcheck-server/SKILL.md) when you have server
access, or [phpcheck-url](skills/phpcheck-url/SKILL.md) when you only have a URL:

```text
$phpcheck-url check https://example.com
```

```text
$phpcheck-server check the PHP version serving my site
```

## Run directly

Check a website:

```sh
node phpcheck.js "https://example.com"
```

## Results

| Result | Exit code | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OK` | `0` | Advertised version meets an upstream fixed release. |
| `POTENTIALLY VULNERABLE` | `1` | Advertised version is in an affected range. |
| `UNKNOWN` | `3` | Missing or unrecognized version, prerelease, or failed check. |

Use `--json` for machine-readable output. `patch_status` is `ok`,
`potentially_vulnerable` or `unknown`. Invalid arguments exit with code `2`.

Versions below a listed upstream fix return `potentially_vulnerable` and
exit `1`. PHP 5.4–5.6, 7.0–7.4, 8.0 and 8.1 also return this warning, even
with a higher patch number such as 8.1.35.

## URL checks

URL mode reads `X-Powered-By` and `Server`, sends `HEAD`, and falls back to
`GET` only when `HEAD` returns 405 or 501. It does not follow redirects or
inspect response bodies. Missing or hidden PHP headers return `UNKNOWN`.

The upstream fixed releases are 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12, from the
[October 21 PHP advisory](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5).
HTTP headers cannot tell whether the version contains a backported fix. Even `OK`
only describes the advertised version - it doesn't verify the installation!
The checker does not send exploit probes.

reports and non-code feedback are welcome through GitHub issues. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

A library of names for the things you ask an AI to make. Each name comes with a moving sample, a one-line meaning and an example of how to ask for it. Eight sets are in it now, 24 names each and 192 in all: motion-graphics moves (`motion`), camera moves (`camera`), UI component names (`ui`), landing page and web effects (`lp`), photo looks, lighting and styles (`photo`), motion-graphics moves, part 2 (`motion2`), landing page and web effects, part 2 (`lp2`), and camera moves and transitions, part 2 (`camera2`). ## Why I made this

I posted a few short videos that put names to motion-graphics moves and camera moves, and over the next few days a lot of comments came in. One of them said, in essence, that what had been holding them back was not a lack of imagination. It was not knowing what this kind of movement is called.

Reading that, I thought: if people who know their field, in many languages, laid out the "common language" you need to work well with AI as a library you can look through, it would be really useful. So I tried making that as a GitHub repository.

This is not one style to copy. It is a place where you can use the prompts and instructions here to make motion graphics like these, and to make the same kind of name samples for your own field, in your own language, with whatever look you like.

Another comment said: "this is how you become a creative director". Exactly. I think it would be a wonderful thing if there were more creative directors all over the world, doing great work together with AI.
